facts.text: PhD F advised Grad G that if he had a large number of small jobs to run, he should not run more than about ten jobs of his own at a time, because saturating the network would keep other people's jobs from running promptly.
facts.source_quote: because um , you don't wanna saturate the network . Uh , so , um , you know , you should {disfmarker} you should probably not run more than , say ten jobs yourself at any one time , uh , just because then it would keep other people {disfmarker}

facts.text: PhD F said that if everybody ran fifty jobs at once, it would bring everything to a halt and delay everyone's jobs, since the compute resources are shared.
facts.source_quote: if everybody ran fifty jobs at once then it would just bring everything to a halt and , you know , people 's jobs would get delayed , so it 's sort of a sharing thing .

facts.text: Professor C recalled a workshop, either at Rutgers or Hopkins (he could not remember which), where a P-make-like system was used to send jobs out to twenty-five machines.
facts.source_quote: I remember I {disfmarker} I forget whether it was when the Rutgers or {disfmarker} or Hopkins workshop , I remember one of the workshops I was at there were {disfmarker} everybody was real excited cuz they got twenty - five machines and there was some kind of P - make like thing that sit sent things out .

facts.text: At that workshop, all twenty-five people were sending their jobs to all twenty-five machines.
facts.source_quote: So all twenty - five people were sending things to all twenty - five machines

facts.text: Professor C said that as a result, things were a lot less efficient than if each person had just used their own machine.
facts.source_quote: and {vocalsound} and things were a lot less efficient than if you 'd just use your own machine .

relations.text: Because all twenty-five workshop participants sent jobs to all twenty-five shared machines at once, the result was worse efficiency than if each person had used their own machine.
relations.source_quote: and {vocalsound} and things were a lot less efficient than if you 'd just use your own machine .

relations.text: Professor C's workshop anecdote about twenty-five people overwhelming twenty-five shared machines illustrates the same shared-resource contention problem that PhD F had just warned Grad G about.
